question: Select the option that is different from the rest.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:** Both letters are opposite to each other.**

Option 1) UF ⇒ Opposite letter

Option 2) TG ⇒ Opposite letter

Option 3) VE ⇒ Opposite letter

**Option 4) QK ⇒ Not Opposite letters (Q ⇔ J)**

So, **option 4 **is different from the rest.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
